fields.quoted_span: A landlord shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause.
fields.note: The at-fault and no-fault causes, notice, relocation, right of first offer, Commission notice, buyout, retaliation and remedies provisions all match §§ 98.0704–98.0710.

fields.quoted_span: damages of not less than three times the actual economic damages
fields.note: The two-month and three-month relocation amounts, the 15-day payment or rent waiver, the 30/60-day notice, the five-year offer with 30 days to accept, and the 3x relocation-failure remedy are all in §§ 98.0706 and 98.0709.
§ 98.0704 was added 5-25-2023 and is effective 6-24-2023. The amendment is effective 3-28-2024.
The document is the 3-2024 code version showing the section as current. It does not use the words 'in force'.
